programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: Wanneer interieurontwerpster Lily Summers uit Seattle terugkeert naar haar geboortestad om haar tante Maggie te helpen met haar bed & breakfast aan de jachthaven, ontmoet ze Marcus.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: De gepassioneerde modestyliste Rose leeft haar beste leven in NYC wanneer ze plotseling de vintage jurkenwinkel van haar grootmoeder erft en terug moet naar haar kleine geboortestad.

programme.title: All Roads Lead To Rome
programme.desc: De strikte New Yorkse single mum Maggie neemt in deze zonnige romkom haar lastige dochter Summer op sleeptouw naar Toscane. Vooral om wat quality time met haar te hebben, maar Maggie vind 't ook wel heel leuk als ze daar ex Luca tegen het gebronsde lijf loopt.

programme.title: Good Deeds
programme.desc: Als hoofd van het familiebedrijf Deeds Corporation heeft Wesley (Tyler Perry) altijd gedaan wat er van hem verwacht wordt, maar als hij een alleenstaande moeder met problemen ontmoet, gaat hij het leven leiden dat hij altijd gewild heeft.

programme.title: Moonrise Kingdom
programme.desc: Als in de zomer van 1965 de verliefde tieners Sam (Jared Gilman) en Suzy (Kara Hayward) van huis weglopen, is het anders zo rustige eiland aan de Amerikaanse oostkust in rep en roer. Iedereen wordt gemobiliseerd om de twee op te sporen...

programme.title: Before We Go
programme.desc: New York City. Een jonge vrouw (Alice Eve) haast zich om de trein van 1.30 uur naar Boston te halen. Onderweg wordt ze overvallen en lijkt ze er helemaal alleen voor te staan. Vervolgens ontmoet ze een man (Chris Evans) waarmee ze in de loop van de nacht een onwaarschijnlijke band opbouwt.

programme.title: A Few Best Men
programme.desc: In deze hilarische komedie sluit de Britse David zijn jaartje backpacken wel heel origineel af. Vlak voor zijn terugreis vraagt hij zijn Australische travel mate Mia ten huwelijk en ze zegt ja!

programme.title: De Escort
programme.desc: Een seksverslaafde journalist, die wanhopig op zoek is naar een goed verhaal, begeeft zich in de wereld van de high-class escorts wanneer hij een prostituee volgt die afgestudeerd is aan Stanford.

programme.title: Date and Switch
programme.desc: Middelbare scholieren sluiten een pact om hun maagdelijkheid te verliezen door prom - dan kondigt men aan dat hij homo is.

programme.title: Rules Of Attraction
programme.desc: Vergeet alles wat je denkt te weten over hoger onderwijs en bereid je voor om geschoold te worden op het gebied van maagdelijkheid, onzekerheid en losbandigheid in deze duistere satire over het leven, de liefde en het streven naar zonde.

programme.title: Love Hurts
programme.desc: Het plezier van rokkenjager Paul vergaat hem al snel als hij een weekend moet doorbrengen met zijn ouders, zijn ex-vrouw en hun kinderen, wat tot een hele reeks knotsgekke situaties leidt.

programme.title: Wild Mountain Thyme
programme.desc: Al haar hele leven is de koppige Rosemary verliefd op haar verlegen buurman Anthony. Hij weet zich echter geen raad met haar gevoelens. Daarbij heeft hij zijn handen vol aan zijn eigenwijze vader Tony, die hun boerderij wil verkopen aan zijn succesvolle Amerikaanse neef Adam.

programme.title: Never Too Late
programme.desc: De vier oude vrienden Caine, Bronson, Angus en Wendell, ook wel “The Chain Breakers” genoemd hebben jaren geleden samen in de Vietnamoorlog gevochten. Nu zitten ze vast in een bejaardentehuis voor oorlogsveteranen, terwijl ze zich eigenlijk nog jong voelen en hun dromen willen najagen...

programme.title: A Kid in King Arthur's Court
programme.desc: Calvin Fuller is een student uit Californië die op magische wijze naar het verleden getransporteerd wordt door Merlijn de Tovenaar. De prinses is ontvoerd door een kwaadaardige tiran en hij is koning Arthurs laatste hoop om haar te redden.

programme.title: Smoorverliefd
programme.desc: Deze heerlijke romantische feelgoodfilm draait om de romantische verwikkelingen in de turbulente levens van vier vrouwen in Den Haag.

programme.title: Accidental Family
programme.desc: Een eenzaam meisje vindt eindelijk de perfecte familie en de liefde van haar leven... ze weten het alleen nog niet! Zij denken dat ze een lang verloren familielid is en hij is helaas verloofd met het verkeerde meisje.

programme.title: The Company
programme.desc: Verhaal over een groep balletdansers, waarin de aandacht vooral uitgaat naar een jonge danseres die op het punt staat door te breken. Ze verliest haar aandacht voor de zware studie door andere interesses, waaronder haar niet-dansende vriendje.

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Books is een gepensioneerde revolverheld die stervende is aan kanker en hij bevindt zich in een stad vol mensen die graag naam willen maken door de revolverheld te zijn die hem vermoordt.

programme.title: Ellis In Glamourland
programme.desc: Film over een vrouw die meedoet aan een cursus om een miljonair te leren versieren. Zij kent weinig scrupules, en haar medecursisten al helemaal niet. Schaamteloos zetten zij hun nagels in rijke heren op de golfclub, op cocktailparty's en familiefeesten.

programme.title: A Taste of Love
programme.desc: Een worstelende tv-chef keert naar huis terug en ontdekt dat het restaurant van haar familie te koop staat, niet in staat om te concurreren met de hedendaagse keuken. In een poging het te redden, hernieuwt ze het contact met haar jeugdliefde en vindt ze de inspiratie die ze zocht.

programme.title: Sleeping With Other People
programme.desc: Jaren nadat ze elkaar als studenten ontmaagden, komen Lainey (Alison Brie) en Jake (Jason Sudeikis) elkaar weer tegen bij een praatgroep voor seksverslaafden in New York.

programme.title: Love is a Gun
programme.desc: Eric Roberts en Kelly Preston spatten van het scherm af in dit sexy en spannende moordmysterie. Jack Hart is een forensisch fotograaf die er een handje van heeft mensen tegen de haren in te strijken.

programme.title: Dream A Little Dream
programme.desc: De bejaarde Coleman en de jonge onbezonnen Bobby leren hoe het leven is vanuit elkaars oogpunt wanneer hun lichamen onbewust worden gewisseld door middel van transcendente meditatie.

programme.title: Allemaal Familie
programme.desc: In ALLEMAAL FAMILIE is iedereen binnen de familie de Roover op een punt in zijn leven beland waarin het maken van cruciale keuzes onvermijdelijk is.

programme.title: Harvey's laatste kans (Last Chance Harvey)
programme.desc: Een ploeterende New Yorkse jingleschrijver (Dustin Hoffman) en een eenzame Britse bureaucraat (Emma Thompson) ontmoeten elkaar bij toeval in Londen en geven een nieuwe draai aan elkaars leven.

programme.title: The Beauty Of Love
programme.desc: Emma heeft een lifestyle website waar ze haar hart en ziel in legt genaamd "Classically Emma". Maar wanneer haar kijkcijfers beginnen te dalen, denkt ze dat ze haar oplossing heeft gevonden in een partnerschap met een ambitieuze millennial genaamd Jill die haar eigen dromen heeft.

programme.title: Playing for Keeps
programme.desc: Pijnstillers is de nieuwste Carry Slee verfilming van de makers van Spijt! Casper heeft zijn vader nooit leren kennen en woont alleen met zijn moeder Marit. In zijn vrije tijd zit hij het liefst achter de piano. Hij is dan ook heel blij als hij wordt gekozen om pianist te worden in een jeugdorkest.

programme.title: The Song To My Heart
programme.desc: Na haar hele jeugd haar vader, een legendarische zanger-liedjesschrijver, op tournee te hebben gevolgd, wil tearoomeigenares BONNIE HIGHSTREET niets meer te maken hebben met de muziekbusiness. Toch helpt ze muzieksensatie RYDER JAMISON teksten te schrijven voor zijn nieuwe soloalbum.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Verleiding: Bekentenissen van een relatietherapeut
programme.desc: Judith is een hard werkende, gedreven vrouw in een liefdevol, maar passieloos huwelijk. Haar leven verandert als ze een aantrekkelijke, extreem rijke man ontmoet die haar verleidt tot een stomende affaire.

programme.title: Leve Boerenliefde
programme.desc: Deze romantische plattelandskomedie draait om boer Jelte (Cas Jansen), die na het verlies van zijn vrouw weinig zin heeft in een nieuw romantisch avontuur. En al helemaal niet met iemand die het boerenleven niet begrijpt.

programme.title: Teach Me Love
programme.desc: De romantische komedie Teach Me Love, met in de hoofdrollen Pierce Brosnan, Salma Hayek en Jessica Alba, is de nieuwste romkom van regisseur Tom Vaughan, bekend van films als Extraordinary Measures en What Happens in Vegas.

programme.title: The Cat's Meow
programme.desc: In 1924 heeft mediamagnaat William Randolph Hearst de grootste beroemdheden ter wereld verzameld voor een reis op zijn jacht die leidt tot een nog steeds onopgeloste, geheim gehouden moord.

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: Nadat ze haar leven in de grote stad achter zich heeft gelaten, is huwelijksfotografe Jessie Brookes gelukkiger dan ooit. Wanneer de beroemde acteur Nate Brown opduikt in de wijngaard van de ouders voor de bruiloft van zijn zus, realiseert zij zich al snel dat er meer met hem aan de hand is.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E03 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E04 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 4 - Holland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E05 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 5 - Holland 2023
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E06 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - World's Strongest Latino
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E07 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E08 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 8 - Portugal
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E09 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 9 - England
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E10 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 10 - World's Strongest Viking
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E14 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 14 - South Africa
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E15 Stage 15 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E16 Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E07 Stage 7 - FINLAND - 2024 - World record breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E15 Stage 15 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 1
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E16 Stage 16 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 2
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.sub-title: S11 : E07 Stage 07 - Worlds Strongest Viking - Finland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.sub-title: S11 : E08 Stage 08 - Worlds Strongest Latino - Portugal
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.sub-title: S11 : E09 Stage 09 - Worlds Strongest Truckpull - England
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.sub-title: S11 : E13 Stage 13 - SCL USA Part 2
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.sub-title: S11 : E16 Stage 16 - South Africa Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.sub-title: S11 : E17 Stage 17 - South Africa Part 2
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World’s Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 16, Malaysia (World Finals Part 2)

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 3, Holland
programme.desc: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 4, Finland
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 5, Bulgaria
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 6, Latvia
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 7, Croatia
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 8, Poland
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 9, Austria
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 10, Romania
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Serving Sara
programme.desc: Wanneer Sara tijdens haar verblijf in New York scheidingspapieren voorgeschoteld krijgt, is ze erg overstuur. Ze is niet van plan het fortuin van haar Texaanse echtgenoot te verliezen, en besluit haar advocaat een aanbod te doen. Dit zorgt ervoor dat ze op een wilde road-trip belanden.

programme.title: The Trials of Cate McCall
programme.desc: Een voormalig vooraanstaande advocate heeft te kampen met een alcoholverslaving en is erdoor totaal vervreemd geraakt van haar familie. Ze wil zich, na een schorsing voor dit alcoholprobleem, rehabiliteren op haar werk en de voogdij herwinnen over haar dochter.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: Wat heeft een team extreme sporters dat niets anders doet dan big-wave surfing, wingsuit flying, extreme snowboarding, freeclimbing en motorracen te maken met een serie gewelddadige overvallen?

programme.title: Closed Circuit
programme.desc: Martin en Claudia zijn, behalve dat ze allebei advocaat zijn, ook ex-geliefden. Wanneer ze beiden de verdediging op zich nemen van een internationale terrorist, wordt hun loyaliteit op de proef gesteld en dreigt hun leven in gevaar te komen.

programme.title: 1918: Journey's End
programme.desc: Vier dagen in maart 1918 in de loopgraven aan het front. Een kleine groep soldaten wacht op een bombardement door vijandelijke artillerie en een zekere dood.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way
programme.desc: Het gedoe begint als Broadway-regisseur Arnold de nacht doorbrengt met Izzy (Imogen Poots). De jonge prostituee wil dolgraag actrice worden en Arnold besluit Izzy fors te betalen om haar op weg te helpen. Het gevolg is een en al verwarring, jaloezie, onbegrip en andere kolderieke situaties.

programme.title: Hercules in New York
programme.desc: Hercules (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wordt verbannen van Olympus en naar de Aarde gestuurd waar hij ware liefde vindt en een veelbelovende carrière begint als bodybuilder.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep
programme.desc: Christine Lucas wordt 's morgens wakker naast een voor haar wildvreemde man. Als ze in de spiegel kijkt herkent ze zichzelf nauwelijks. Ze ziet een vrouw van veertig terwijl ze denkt dat ze twintig is.

programme.title: Arthur & Mike
programme.desc: Wallace Avery haat zijn leven. Zijn baan is doodsaai, zijn ex-vrouw en kinderen ziet hij nauwelijks en zijn nieuwe vriendin irriteert hem. Hij besluit helemaal opnieuw te beginnen.

programme.title: Before We Go
programme.desc: New York City. Een jonge vrouw (Alice Eve) haast zich om de trein van 1.30 uur naar Boston te halen. Onderweg wordt ze overvallen en lijkt ze er helemaal alleen voor te staan. Vervolgens ontmoet ze een man (Chris Evans) waarmee ze in de loop van de nacht een onwaarschijnlijke band opbouwt.

programme.title: Knight of Shadows
programme.desc: Dämonenjäger Pu Songling beschützt die Menschen vor bösen Kreaturen der Unterwelt. Dabei erhält er Unterstützung von einer Horde gutmütiger Dämonen und dem angehenden Polizisten Fei...

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Na een auto-ongeluk lijdt Dan Merrick aan geheugenverlies. Hij komt er weer achter dat hij getrouwd is met Judith, die hem helpt om zijn geheugen terug te krijgen. Dan heeft last van flashbacks omtrent gebeurtenissen waar hij niets van kan herinneren.

programme.title: Level 16
programme.desc: De zestienjarige Vivien zit vast in The Vestalis Academy, een kostschool die veel weg heeft van een gevangenis. Ze zondert zich af en steekt voor niemand haar nek uit, totdat ze herenigd wordt met Sophia, een vriendin van vroeger die haar toentertijd verraden heeft.

programme.title: Blood Father
programme.desc: Ex-gedetineerde John Link (Mel Gibson) wordt na jaren herenigd met zijn eigenzinnige 16-jarige dochter. Zij wordt achternagezeten door leden van een Mexicaans drugskartel die er op uit zijn haar te vermoorden.

programme.title: Dik Trom - De Vetste Film
programme.desc: Dik Trom is een vrolijke, eerlijke, maar vooral gezette jongen. Samen met zijn ouders woont hij in het knusse Dikkedam, waar iedereen net zo dik en uitbundig is als hij. Het is er elke dag feest.

programme.title: Burn
programme.desc: De eenzame en labiele Melinda is werkzaam op een benzinestation waar ze zich voortdurend overschaduwd voelt door haar collega Sheila.

programme.title: Weg Van Jou
programme.desc: Romcom die draait om de stadse Evi (Herbers). Met frisse tegenzin wordt ze door haar werkgever van hip Rotterdam overgeplaatst naar stil Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. Dat het niet allemaal onverstaanbare Zeeuwen zijn, blijkt als Evi in Terneuzen de stoere visser Stijn (Heijmans) ontmoet.

programme.title: Hallo Bungalow
programme.desc: In een verlopen bungalowpark, lijkt het saaie lot van drie collega’s (Lies Visschedijk, Eva van der Gucht en Anne-Marie Jung) beschoren. Maar dan ontdekken ze dat hun baas (Stefan de Walle) een dubbele agenda heeft, en het park waar zij al zoveel jaren buffelen, slechts een witwaspraktijk is.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: Nadat de grootmoeder van de familie Graham overlijdt, werpt de aanwezigheid van deze weinig geliefde vrouw nog steeds een schaduw op het gezin.

programme.title: Whip It
programme.desc: In dit inspirerende drama van regisseuse Diane Keaton schittert Reese Witherspoon als een tiener die vriendinnen wordt met een gedeeltelijk doof en epileptisch meisje dat misbruikt is door haar stiefvader.

programme.title: Army of One
programme.desc: Gary Faulkner is een ex-gevangene, werkloze klusjesman, Amerikaan en trots op zijn vaderland.

programme.title: Take Down
programme.desc: Na een roekeloos auto-ongeluk is de maat vol voor de families van Kyle en Amy. Samen met zes andere verwende en onhandelbare kinderen van gefrustreerde miljardairs worden ze naar een afgelegen eiland net buiten Schotland gestuurd.

programme.title: The Hustle
programme.desc: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) is een glamoureuze, verleidelijke Brit met een voorliefde voor het bedriegen van goedgelovige rijke mannen. In haar goed geordende wereld barst Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), een Australiër die net zo vrij van vorm en plezier is als Josephine berekend en sluw is.

programme.title: Dirty Grandpa
programme.desc: Over een week gaat de brave advocaat Jason trouwen met Meredith; een ontzettende control freak. Tussen alle trouwdagstress wil zijn opa opeens een lift naar Florida. Maar daar is Spring Break in volle gang en komt het aanstaande huwelijk van Jason plots in gevaar.

programme.title: The Informer
programme.desc: Voormalig special agent Pete Koslow zit een celstraf uit nadat hij in een gevecht zijn vrouw wilde beschermen. Hij krijgt een kans op vroegtijdige vrijlating als hij informant wordt voor de FBI en hen helpt de meest machtige misdadiger van New York neer te halen: The General...

programme.title: Bones and All
programme.desc: In een wereld die ze niet aanvaardt, gaan een jonge vrouw die aan de rand van de samenleving probeert te overleven en een gevoelige zwerver op een autoreis op zoek naar identiteit, en op jacht naar schoonheid in een gevaarlijke wereld.

programme.title: Good Deeds
programme.desc: Als hoofd van het familiebedrijf Deeds Corporation heeft Wesley (Tyler Perry) altijd gedaan wat er van hem verwacht wordt, maar als hij een alleenstaande moeder met problemen ontmoet, gaat hij het leven leiden dat hij altijd gewild heeft.

programme.title: Dansen op de vulkaan
programme.desc: Het verhaal draait om Maarten (Nils Verkooijen), een jongen van 16 die supergoed kan dansen. Elk uurtje dat hij over heeft, is hij in de dansschool te vinden. Maar Maarten draagt een geheim met zich mee dat maar weinig mensen kennen.

programme.title: Reclaim
programme.desc: Steven en Shannon reizen naar Puerto Rico om hun adoptiedochtertje Nina op te halen. Eenmaal aangekomen worden ze voor het eerst verenigd met het 7-jarige weeskindje Nina. Wat begint als een droom verandert in een nachtmerrie wanneer Nina spoorloos uit hun hotelkamer verdwijnt.

programme.title: Brick Mansions
programme.desc: De criminele buitenwijken van Detroit worden overspoeld door geweld en drugs. De gevolgen van misdaad en corrupte raken ieders leven. Bijna dan. Lino (freerunner / parkour master David Belle) levert een dagelijks gevecht om een eerlijk leven te lijden.

programme.title: American pastoral
programme.desc: Seymour “Swede” Levov, in zijn high-school dagen atleet en nu succesvol zakenman, is getrouwd met voormalige beauty queen Dawn. Zijn leven komt op zijn kop te staan als hun dochter Merry wordt beschuldigd van een terroristische aanslag en vervolgens spoorloos verdwijnt.

programme.title: Weg Van Jou
programme.desc: Romcom die draait om de stadse Evi (Herbers). Met frisse tegenzin wordt ze door haar werkgever van hip Rotterdam overgeplaatst naar stil Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. Dat het niet allemaal onverstaanbare Zeeuwen zijn, blijkt als Evi in Terneuzen de stoere visser Stijn (Heijmans) ontmoet.

programme.title: The Survivalist
programme.desc: Anderhalf jaar na een grote virusuitbraak is meer dan 89% van de wereld uitgeroeid. Energie- en waternetwerken zijn kapot en de laatste overlevende worden aan hun lot overgelaten. Zo goed als iedereen komt te overlijden na weer een nieuwe uitbraak. Behalve Sarah.

programme.title: Automata
programme.desc: De film speelt zich af in de toekomst met de wereld op de rand van een ecologische ineenstorting. De wetenschap staat op het punt om haar droom te realiseren met het creëren van kunstmatige intelligentie.

programme.title: Girl in Progress
programme.desc: Als alleenstaande moeder worstelt Grace met werk, rekeningen en haar affaire met een getrouwde dokter. Haar dochter, Ansiedad, probeert snel volwassen te worden met de verhalen over volwassen worden die ze op school leest.

programme.title: Knight of Shadows
programme.desc: Dämonenjäger Pu Songling beschützt die Menschen vor bösen Kreaturen der Unterwelt. Dabei erhält er Unterstützung von einer Horde gutmütiger Dämonen und dem angehenden Polizisten Fei...

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Nadat IP Man (Donnie Yen) in de tweede Chinees Japanse oorlog zijn vechtkunsten tegen de Japanners inzette, vluchtte hij in 1949 naar Hongkong en probeerde daar een Wing Chun vechtschool op te richten. Als de machtige meester Hung dat hoort, stelt hij IP Man voor een opgave.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 World Heritage Agra, India
programme.desc: Travel back in time and explore the monuments and architecture built by the Mughals such as the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort in Agra and Fatehpur Sikri Fort in Fatehpur Sikhri.

programme.desc: Surrounded by turquoise waters, pristine beaches and lush tropical greenery, Koh Samui offers Elisha the perfect blend of serenity and luxury.

Renowned traveller, Alex Outhwaite explores the Uzbekistan capital, where she visits iconic sights such as the Barak-Khan Madrassah, learns about the city’s history, and tries out some local delicacies such as sheesh kebab, horse milk and horse meat.

programme.desc: Hong Kong the estuary where the east meets the west. The city is facinating in every facet of culture, be it cuisine, music,dance or simply lifestyle.

programme.desc: A trip to Jordan leads Shaunak to the ruined city of Jerash, which was buried in sand for hundreds of years until a German explorer rediscovered it. From theatres and temples to the hippodrome, which was once the setting for chariot races and gladiator fights, the ruins of the city offer him a glimpse into the majesty of Roman architecture.

programme.desc: Alex Drobin gets to know the vibe of Toronto at significant spots such as Saint Lauren’s Market and Sir Henry’s Garage for Classic Cars.

Following this, she reaches the city of Ganja, where she uncovers the history at spectacular places such as Heyder Aliyev Park, Mausoleum Imamzadeh, Juma Mosque and Mausoleum Nizami.

programme.title: The Savvy Nomad
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Savvy Nomad Lampung, Thailand
programme.desc: At an elephant conservation centre in Lampang, Emeline experiences the immense love that the Thai people feel for their national animal.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina in Jerusalem, takes a guided tour of City of David and visits Western Wall, learning about its significance. Ending with Cardo and Mahane Yehuda Markets.

programme.desc: Along with basking in the idyllic beach scenes of Bulgaria, Kirsty admires the art in Helena resort, and experiences the local traditions and cuisine.

programme.title: Best From The Rest
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Best From The Rest Hong Kong Top Sees
programme.desc: While Hong Kong may be a haven for social media brags, a closer look at some of its most iconic attractions exposes its authentic richness.

programme.title: Xp Guide
programme.desc: With its rich folk traditions of dance and music, this archipelago is a culmination of fun and frolic to the hilt. With its rich biodiversity.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Bucket List Aso, Japan
programme.desc: Daniel Coll & Paddy Doherty try some adventurous activities at Mount Aso, the caldera that is home to Japan’s most active volcano.

programme.title: Xplore Jordan
programme.desc: During Shaunak’s visit to Amman, one of the world’s oldest cities, he finds himself taken back to a different stage of the city’s history at every turn: from the Greco-Roman roots in the Roman amphitheater to the iconic Grand Husseini Mosque of the powerful Hashemite dynasty and Qusayr Amra, a desert castle, which served as the fortress of the Ummayad Caliphs.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: Valencia, the birthplace of paella, has got the bones of a metropolis and the heart of a quaint seaside town. Alex Outhwaite experiences this when she visits the strikingly futuristic City Of Arts And Sciences and then tries the local specialty, Pinxtos at a Tapas Bar and enjoys Valencia’s laidback charms at El Cabanyal Beach. She also encounters the city’s strong Catholic roots at Cathedral de Valencia, the alleged home of the Holy Grail used by Christ at the Last Supper.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Off The Grid Cork, Ireland
programme.desc: Alex explores Cork, enjoys Irish meal and music, visits Fota Wildlife Park, Blarney castle. He then explores Cork butter museum, ending with a visit to Cork City Gaol-a former prison but now a museum.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Food Fact Fun Quebec, Canada
programme.desc: From the famous deer meat pie of Aux Ancies Canadiens to the art on Rue Du Tresor, Alex Drobin soaks in the vibes of sophisticated yet playful Quebec.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici marvels at the architectural wonders of Baku, the capital of Azerbaijan, while also checking out souvenirs at the local bazaar.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina visits Ein Gedi oasis and Masada plateau on her way to Eilat, where she visits the beaches, Red Canyon and Wadi Shani.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Food Fact Fun Montreal, Canada
programme.desc: Alex Drobin experiences the North American energy and European charm of Montreal as he explores all that the city has to offer.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Off The Grid Wild Atlantic Way 3, Ireland
programme.desc: Alex continues his journey on the Wild Atlantic Way and is in Kinsale. He visits St.Multose Church, Desmond Castle, explores Fanad Head lighthouse and ends his day with exploring the Kinnegar Brewery.

programme.title: Xplore Jordan
programme.desc: Few things excite a seasoned traveler more than navigating a lost city. Shaunak gets a first-hand experience of this in the ancient Jordanian city of Petra. Once a vibrant metropolis ruled by the Nabatean empire, and a thriving trade center for the Romans, Petra was abandoned after over 300 years of Roman reign.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Great World Hotels The Residence
programme.desc: Frieshia feels the magic of Mauritius through the unique blend of modernity and tradition offered at the luxury resort.

programme.title: The Savvy Nomad
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Savvy Nomad Bangkok, Thailand
programme.desc: From meeting the “Queen of Bangkok Street Food” to eating Pad Thai at the place where it was born, Emeline lives a foodie’s dream in Bangkok.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Food Fact Fun Whistler, Canada
programme.desc: Alex starts with Kangaroo meat pie in Whistler with a Australian ginger beer and continuing his food trail he visits Earls kitchen for a tuna dish. He then tries out e-biking and travels in the world’s highest cable car joining Blackcomb with Whistler mountain. Next, he visits Squamish lil’wat cultural center to learn about the Aboriginal people. Finally, he takes a tour of Pemberton valley on a horse, tries Canada’s highest zipline and bungee jumps over the Cheakamus river.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Off The Grid Wild Atlantic Way 2, Ireland
programme.desc: Alex explores Keem beach, visits Dooagh village and the 6000 year old Ceide Fields. Following day, starting with an Irish breakfast, he then explores Donegal and ends the day by enjoying a traditional Irish music.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Bucket List Hitoyoshi, Japan
programme.desc: Daniel Coll & Paddy Doherty ride in a classic steam locomotive to Hitoyoshi, where they enjoy a relaxing hot spring bath in the mountainside.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E24 City Breaks Bikaner, India
programme.desc: Bikaner is known to most people as the city of world-famous savoury snacks. When Asmita goes there for a whirlwind trip, however, she discovers that there is a lot more to Rajasthan’s Red City than meets the eye. From the miniature paintings that can be found on the walls of palaces and mansions across the city to the elaborate architecture of the former havelis of merchants, she finds out that Bikaner is an art lover’s paradise.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Food Fact Fun Niagara, Canada
programme.desc: Alex starts in Niagara with a 5 course meal along with enjoying dance performances near the Niagara falls. Next, exploring the urban space, he visits the Skylon town for a stunning view of the city. Further he visits the Niagara-on-the-lake village and explores its surroundings. He then interacts with a wine expert to learn more about the regional wines. Lastly, Alex is seen exploring the Niagara falls by helicopter, the a tunnel that takes him to the observation desk and then by ferry.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina in Jaffa visits Zodiac fountain, ending with Jaffa Port. She then explores the National Park in Caesarea and concluding after her visit to the shrine of Bab, learning about the Baha'i faith.

programme.title: The Savvy Nomad
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The Savvy Nomad Chiang Rai, Thailand
programme.desc: While exploring the extraordinary temples in Chiang Rai, Emeline begins to uncover the stories hidden in their fascinating architecture.

programme.title: Off The Grid
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Off The Grid Wild Atlantic Way 1, Ireland
programme.desc: On the Wild Atlantic Way Alex drives all the way and stops at Cliffs of Moher. He understands the Irish culture at Kildare village, visits the Claddagh Art Center and Ireland School of Falconry.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Food Fact Fun Vancouver Island, Canada
programme.desc: Alex is in Vancouver Island and calls for Saffron salmon at Modern Cafe. Next he visits “Red fish blue fish” a fish and chip shop and tries freshly prepared seafood. Further explores the Parksville beach for its sand sculptures and then explores a 50 year old Symphony Winery. Further Alex visits “Eagle wing whale watching” for fun and knowledge about the ocean life. To add to the adventure rush he tries motocross and then snorkels in cold waters of Nanaimo.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina visits Acre, starting from El Jazzar mosque and Citadel fortress. Next day she travels to Mizpe Hayamim and then explores the town of Capernaum.

programme.title: 10 Days Korea
programme.desc: From markets and temples to a palace that was the headquarters of one of Medieval Asia’s biggest empires, Andrew explores the iconic sights of Seoul.

programme.title: Xplore Jordan
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Xplore Jordan, Dead Sea
programme.desc: In 560 AD, an elaborate mosaic map of the Holy Land was made on the floor of a Byzantine church in Jordan. Today, it is the world’s oldest surviving original cartographic depiction of the biblical nations. When Shaunak visits the church, he finds out that the city where it is located, Madaba, is home to a treasure of ancient mosaics, and that the age-old art form of mosaic-making is still practiced there.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Food Fact Fun Vancouver, Canada
programme.desc: Alex starts his Vancouver exploration by visiting Bridges restaurant where he tries smoked salmon pizza with some seafood. Then he visits the Richmond Night Market and then Treasure Cafe. Later visits the Steel Toad Brewery in Olympic Village. Next he explores the Gastown, including the steam clock. Further he explores the Hills Native Art ending with Vancouver observation deck. Next he rides on board the Grouse Mountain Skyride, ending with Capilano Suspension Bridge park.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Backpack Tel Aviv, Israel
programme.desc: Sabrina visits Israel and first explores Sarona, including its local market, and tries local food and wine. Her next stop is Jaffa exploring its flea market ending with Shakshuka Shushka.

programme.title: 10 Days Korea
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 10 Days Korea, Jeju Island
programme.desc: From a volcano rising out of the sea to a village of tough old female divers, Andrew Maciver explores everything that is unique about Jeju island.

programme.title: Xplore Jordan
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Xplore Jordan, Wadi Rum
programme.desc: Imagine an endless expanse of red punctuated with weathered masses of rock formations – sounds like Mars? This is Wadi Rum in Jordan. It’s a town that has been inhabited since prehistoric times and is now home to Bedouin camps. The highlight of Shaunak’s trip, however, is when he finds an ancient map hidden in a cave.

programme.title: 10 Days Korea
programme.desc: Andrew Maciver dives headlong into deeply traditional South Korean experiences at Busan, the country’s favourite seaside escape.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sheki, the silk route city of Azerbaijan, is all kinds of indulgence, as Sabrina Chakici finds out. She learns about the unique play of colour and glass that is Shabaka, a traditional art form, and sees how beautifully it has been used in the mesmerizing Sheki Summer House. She also pampers herself with a relaxing crude oil spa treatment, and goes on to explore Khinalug Village, a hidden gem.

programme.title: The Savvy Nomad
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Savvy Nomad Koh Tao, Thailand
programme.desc: Emeline visits Koh Tao - a small island in the Gulf of Thailand often referred to as a ‘diver’s paradise’.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sabrina is in Tiberias, known for its natural hot springs, here she visits the Sea of Galilee. In Nezareth she visits the cave of Mary, ending with Via Dolorosa in Jerusalem.

programme.title: Otters and the Exotic Pet Trade
programme.desc: Tracking the exotic pet trade of otters across the globe, is a story of gangsters and guns, mammals, and middlemen. Japanese otter cafés and social media influencers are driving increased demand for pet otters all over the world, with devastating consequences. These otters might be adorable, but the truth behind this trade is anything but. Ripped from the wild or irresponsibly bred, orphaned by poachers and confined in unnatural environments, these otters live a life of extreme misery. Following World Animal Protection intelligence, environmental photojournalist Aaron Gekoski investigates Otters and the Exotic Pet Trade.

programme.title: LINE OF SIGHT | A Look into Wingsuit BASE Jumping

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 On Your Mark, Get Set, Duel!
programme.desc: Within Satellite, a location segregated from a luxurious utopia, New Domino City; lies Yusei Fudo, a young duelist and Duel Runner enthusiast who is plotting revenge against his rival and former friend, Jack Atlas, the current King of New Domino City in an attempt to reclaim his stolen Duel Runner and "Stardust Dragon" card. However, Yusei must first deal with Sector Security as they attempt to arrest his friend Rally Dawson for stealing a Duel Runner piece for Yusei's Duel Runner.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei reminisces about the past whilst developing his Duel Runner in preparation for sneaking into New Domino City and reclaiming what was stolen from him. In the meantime, Blitz, Nervin and Tank become involved in a fight with Lenny, Lug and Larry who then turn up at Yusei's hideout and demand his Duel Runner. To protect his friends and their bonds, Yusei duels Lenny with his Duel Runner on the line.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The time has finally arrived for Yusei to sneak into New Domino City so he can settle the score with Jack and reclaim what was stolen from him. However, Tetsu Trudge interrupts Yusei's plan and uses the imposed "Speed World" to force Yusei into a Turbo Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 A Blast from the Past, Part 1
programme.desc: Yusei finally manages to meet Jack in New Domino. Here, they hold a Turbo Duel with Yusei's "Stardust Dragon" on the line. Yusei is determine to have his card back and get his revenge on his former friend.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 A Blast from the Past, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei continues his Turbo Duel with Jack after Jack has managed to Summon both their aces "Red Dragon Archfiend" and "Stardust Dragon". Yusei is able to gain control of "Stardust Dragon" with "Harmonia Mirror". But unknown to them, the summoning of the two dragons trigger an event that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo has been caught by the Sector Security and sent to the Facility. In the paddy wagon, he meets a man called Tenzen Yanagi whom he befriends. The former Pro Duelist, Bolt Tanner, meets Yusei there. Tanner challenges Yusei, who is unable to Duel since he doesn't have a Deck. As a result, Yanagi Duels in his place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Disgusted by Tanner speaking ill of Yanagi's cards and stomping on them, Yusei Duels Tanner using Yanagi's Deck, in order to teach him that no card is truly unneeded (in the dub he wanted to teach him what respect really means).

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Securities examine Yusei's body for confirmation of his Mark of the Dragon. Meanwhile, Jack has learned of the legend of the Crimson Dragon and forces himself to obey Goodwin and hosts a Turbo Duel between him and Hunter Pace, who wants a rematch with him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 The Lockdown Duel, Part 1
programme.desc: Mr. Armstrong harasses Yusei's friends in front of him and Yusei duels Armstrong with his freedom and the safety of his friends on the line. Armstrong has seized all of Yusei's Decks so Yusei duels him using cards given to him from his friends at the Facility.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 The Lokcdown Duel, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei continues his Duel with Mr. Armstrong, using cards given to him by inmates at the Facility. Despite Armstrong's brutal attack, Yusei refuses to abandon his friends and lose his freedom.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 The Take Back, Part 1
programme.desc: In order to get back his Deck and Duel Runner, Yusei meets a man named Blister, but he is soon pursued by Trudge, who still wants to get his revenge on Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 The Take Back, Part 2
programme.desc: Yusei, who got back his Duel Runner and his Deck, continued his Turbo Duel with Trudge. Blister, who is witnessing the Turbo Duel, does not understand why Yusei is so determined to retrieve his "Bonds of Friendship".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 A Duel to Remember
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo is left unconscious after his harsh Duel with Trudge. The twins Leo and Luna rescue him. After Yusei regains consciousness, Leo demands a Duel with him. Meanwhile, Trudge waits outside in the hopes of capturing Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Bloom of the Black Rose
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo decides to enter the Fortune Cup, after Lazar blackmailed him to do so, if he wants to see his friends at Satellite alive. programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Attack from the Deep
programme.desc: The fisherman duelist baits Yugi into a duel on his own sea playing field for a home-field advantage. Can Yugi adapt to these new settings to turn the tide of battle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: If Yugi is eliminated from the tournament, KaibaCorp’s crooked Board of Directors will transfer control of the company from Kaiba to Pegasus! Kaiba’s brother Mokuba challenges Yugi to a duel to protect his brother’s company!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Duel With a Ghoul
programme.desc: Yugi must duel a magical doppelganger of Kaiba. But with his best cards resting at the bottom of the ocean, Yugi must discover a new strategy to survive fake Kaiba’s powerful Blue-Eyes White Dragon!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Give up the Ghost
programme.desc: Yugi defeats Blue-Eyes White Dragon, but there are two more waiting in the wings! Will the real Kaiba reach Yugi in time to help beat this impersonator?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decides to battle Rex Raptor without his friends’ help to prove that he is man enough to take care of Serenity on his own. But as Rex Raptor’s relentless dinos destroys Joey’s best Duel Monsters, will Tristan’s card remind him that with his friends, he is never alone in battle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey duels valiantly, but Rex Raptor has unleashed his secret weapon: Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Joey must figure out the secret of Yugi’s gift, the Time Wizard card, without Yugi’s help or he’s taking the next boat out of Duelist Kingdom!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Evil Spirit of the Ring
programme.desc: Yugi’s classmate Bakura, possessed by his Millennium Ring’s dark powers, traps Yugi and friends in a Shadow Game where they become the cards themselves! Not only must Yugi battle to avoid becoming a permanent part of the card game, but also free Bakura’s soul from the Millennium Ring’s control!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 The Light at the End of the Tunnel
programme.desc: Pegasus’s hired duelist PaniK cheats Mai of all her Star Chips, and Yugi vows to defeat him and win them back. But when PaniK’s Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, how can Yugi defeat an enemy he cannot see?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite his astonishing disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes PaniK: “I’ll finish you in three turns.” Is Yugi bluffing, or does he have the advantage in this battle of wits?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 The Scars of Defeat
programme.desc: Kaiba descends to the kingdom to face Pegasus! Has Kaiba changed since his battle with Yugi, or is he still the same merciless duelist? A battle between Kaiba’s Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon holds the answers!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 Arena of Lost Souls, Part 1
programme.desc: The #1 American duelist Bandit Keith’s gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave! Joey is all alone in the battle this time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 Arena of Lost Souls, Part 2
programme.desc: Joey’s last ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizard card, fails against Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters. But as his lucky streak comes to an end, will his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him to victory?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Double Trouble Duel, Part 1
programme.desc: Trapped in the labyrinth cave, Yugi and friends find an alternate exit, but the door is guarded by Pegasus’s Paradox Brothers. Yugi and Joey will no longer be battling solo; they band together in a team battle against the Paradox Brothers! The battle for all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus’s castle is on the line!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Double Trouble Duel, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey pool their strengths and manage to fend off their opponents’ monsters, but things are about to change as the Paradox Brothers summon the almighty Gate Guardian, a monster that reflects all attacks! Is Joey helping Yugi in this duel, or his lack of experience sealing their fate for defeat?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 Double Trouble Duel, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey each unleash their strongest monster, Summoned Skull and Red-Eyes B. Dragon, but their strength pales in comparison to the tremendous power of Gate Guardian. Individually, our heroes have no chance, but they will unleash the greatest power of all: teamwork!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Using the magic of the Millennium Eye, Pegasus traps Mokuba’s soul inside a card right before Kaiba’s eyes! In order to earn the right to challenge Pegasus, Kaiba must first beat Yugi and take his Star Chips. The rematch between Yugi and Kaiba is about to begin!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba summons Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue-Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi’s heart is split in two!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Having lost his Star Chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Téa bring Yugi back to consciousness by defeating Mai for her extra Star Chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Champion Vs. Creator, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegasus with Mokuba’s soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people’s minds. Can Kaiba defeat an opponent who knows his moves even before he does?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 Champion Vs. Creator, Part 2
programme.desc: Kaiba is helpless against Pegasus’s Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities. As the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba’s soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba! Yugi has had enough!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: T’was the night before the final battle, and many creatures are stirring! Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus for the sake of his Grandpa. Tristan leads an exploration party to uncover Pegasus’s secrets. While Joey sleeps, Bandit Keith steals from him the card that permits his entry in the final battle!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Under Pegasus’s weighty glare, Yugi is distracted from his duel with Mai. After making foolish tactical errors and allowing Mai to gain a huge advantage with her Harpie's Pet Dragon, will Yugi gather his focus or succumb to the intense pressure?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E33 Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 1
programme.desc: With his pride in his strength as a duelist on the line, Joey challenges Yugi for the right to face Pegasus. In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other’s strategies and cards as they struggle to keep their thoughts of past loyalties at the back of their minds.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E34 Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him, the very card he gave Joey as a sign of friendship! However, as the two battle each other valiantly and one comes out the victor, they find confirmation of the strength of their friendship that surpasses any duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E35 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba and Mokuba on the line. Meanwhile, Tristan and Bakura infiltrate the castle to find the Kaiba brothers, but at this crucial moment, is Bakura turning back into his evil self again?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E36 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi’s monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi’s soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya takes on a terrifying trio from Fusion Dimension who turn their victims into cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Outnumbered, outmatched, and out of options, will Yuya tap into a deep-seeded darkness to overcome defeat?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Zuzu races to stay one step ahead of a cold-blooded hunter who's hot on her heels! Can Zuzu ditch this danger, or will he prove too cunning for her to escape?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The third day of the preliminaries begins with Yuma looking for one more Heart Piece. Meanwhile, Nistro who wants to defeat Yuma and Astral, enters the tournament along with Dextra. Consequently while collecting Heart Pieces, Nistro challenges Nelson Andrews.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After watching the quick Duel between Yuma against Shark, Trey visits Yuma's house in order to learn more about him. He finds a picture of Yuma's parents, and starts thinking about how his family used to be. He becomes very upset and cries, then runs out of Yuma's house. Yuma goes after him, but then Trey gives him a map, and leaves.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Using new powers given to him by Vetrix, Trey is able to break Yuma and Astral's combination. After capturing Astral, Trey makes Yuma forget about "kattobingu" leading him into further trouble as this makes the latter unable to see Astral or Emperor's Key.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Due to Trey's power, Yuma forgets all about "Kattobing" and ends up forced into a corner. However Kazuma, helps Yuma continue the fierce Duel against Trey by using the power of the "Numbers" and Emperor's Key to break Trey's spell. Lastly Astral's last hope helps Yuma make a comeback by using "Utopia".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Sparks fly in the Volcano Zone when all our heroes face off against the full fury of Fusion Dimension's elite Obelisk Force! With more than life points on the line, the action has never been hotter!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya faces a ferocious attack against Michio Mokota's Cooking Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 Trapped in a Card
programme.desc: It's a case of mistaken identity when Yuya is eyed as the primary suspect for attacking Leo students! But when Yuya crosses paths with the real culprit, things go from bad to worse!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya matches minds with the quiz whiz extraordinaire Pierre L'Supérieure in a duel of wits! Can Yuya outsmart the smartest boy on Earth, or will Yuya end up scratching his head in defeat?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: In the finale of the mind-bending match that's part-duel, part-quiz show - one wrong answer could mean curtains for Yuya! Can he outduel and outthink a trivia whiz who's never wrong?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E36 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi’s monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi’s soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E37 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus’s mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus’s Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E38 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi crumples in exhaustion under the crippling power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi’s chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E39 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 5
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi’s Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh? The smallest, weakest creature in the game? Has Yugi given up, or does he have one last strategy to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? The Shadow Game comes to a close!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E68 Jodha Akbar S4 E68
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: This is Fate
programme.sub-title: S04 : E10 This is Fate S4 E10
programme.desc: The story revolves around the two sisters of Pragya, from Kumkum Bhagya. Her sisters are Preeta and Shristhi who discover the existence of their mother Sarla and sister Pragya, after their father’s death. The sisters try to unite with their mother and sister.

programme.title: Guddan
programme.desc: Guddan, a cheerful yet clumsy young woman, ends up marrying Akshat Jindal aka AJ, a rich businessman with three sons and daughters-in-law. How will Guddan face the challenges that await her?

programme.title: Guddan
programme.desc: Guddan, a cheerful yet clumsy young woman, ends up marrying Akshat Jindal aka AJ, a rich businessman with three sons and daughters-in-law. How will Guddan face the challenges that await her?

programme.title: Lies of the Heart
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 Lies of the Heart S1 E17
programme.desc: A woman's struggle in this male dominated society that will leave her to embark on a quest of eternal marital bliss.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E28 A King and His Queen S2 E28
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: My Journey to You
programme.sub-title: S01 : E102 My Journey to You S1 E102
programme.desc: Two people with different opinions on marriage and love, One person carries the scars of a past love, the other is being careful about making impulsive romantic decisions. Amruta has unwavering faith in relationships, while Virat, on the other hand, has reservations about love, Can they find their way into each other's hearts?

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E29 A King and His Queen S2 E29
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E69 Jodha Akbar S4 E69
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.
